facts.fact: CAZOS says Lei n.º 22/11 of 17 June, the data protection law, has been in force for more than a decade; the APD's revision of it, with an AI chapter, finished public consultation in April 2025 and is not in force.
CAZOS says the Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD), created by Presidential Decree 214/16, exists, supervises and has sanctioning powers.
